title: Roles and models: who does the work, who gets consulted
summary: Drake runs one default worker model for nearly everything, keeps stronger read-only consultants for hard calls, and consults only on five named triggers: two different fixes failed or the root cause is unknown, a hard-to-reverse step, contradictory or surprising results, or being unsure something is done or safe. For a real fork he spawns two consultants with the same facts and weighs them. I can show you his rule as a small Omega program you can run.
goal: Run one default worker and consult a stronger model only on named triggers, using two independent consultants for a real fork.
key_steps: Give every lane the same default worker model
Keep consultants read-only: they advise, the worker decides and does the work
Consult only on a trigger: two failed fixes or unknown cause, irreversible step, contradiction, unsure it is done
For a real fork, brief two consultants with the same facts and without your conclusion
Act where they agree; run the cheapest separating check where they disagree
Check which model each role actually resolved to before claiming independence

example.code:
note consult: decide whether to work alone, consult one stronger agent, or consult two
note exit 0 decided every line, 2 read error, 3 malformed line (fail closed)
text KW "WORK alone (no trigger: routine work)\nCONSULT one consultant\nCONSULT two independent consultants, same facts (real fork)\n  why: \ntwo different fixes failed\nroot cause unknown\nhard to reverse\nresults contradict or surprise\nunsure it is done or safe\nREFUSE malformed line \n: \n\nconsult=\n work=\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
note a line is six fields then a label: F R I C U K label
note F failed different fixes (0..9), R root cause unknown, I hard to reverse,
note C results contradict or surprise, U unsure it is done or safe, K real fork (each 0 or 1)
fn fld s ulong i ulong to ulong
c = get inb add s mul i 2
if lt c 48
ret 99
end
if gt c 57
ret 99
end
v = ulong sub c 48
if gt i 0
if gt v 1
ret 99
end
end
ret v
end
fn shape s ulong e ulong to bool
if lt sub e s 13
ret false
end
for i ulong 6
if eq fld s i 99
ret false
end
if ne get inb add s add mul i 2 1 32
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn why k ulong to void
word 3
say k
end
fn reasons s ulong to void
if ge fld s 0 2
why 4
end
for i ulong 4
if eq fld s add i 1 1
why add i 5
end
end
end
fn decide s ulong e ulong to ulong
emiti add s 12 sub e add s 12
word 10
if lt fld s 0 2
if eq fld s 1 0
if eq fld s 2 0
if eq fld s 3 0
if eq fld s 4 0
say 0
ret 0
end
end
end
end
end
if eq fld s 5 1
say 2
else
say 1
end
reasons s
ret 1
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
s = ulong 0
w = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
ln = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
ln = add ln 1
if not shape s e
word 9
emitu ln
say 11
ret 3
end
if eq decide s e 1
c = add c 1
else
w = add w 1
end
s = add e 1
end
word 12
emitu c
word 13
emitu w
say 11
ret 0
end

common_mistake: Consulting by habit (wasted budget, unclear who decided) or never consulting and then reporting an unsure change as done. Fix: consult only on the trigger list, and brief two consultants with facts, not your conclusion, when there is a real fork.

evidence_note: The example ran on a Linux AArch64 host (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte with a negative control. Rests on the recorded run of consult.om, which encodes the consult triggers from Drake's agent rules. NOT done: no measurement of how consulting changes agent outcomes or cost.
